senses.gloss: ‘anything coming from or belonging to an ox or cow’, milk (generally pl.), flesh (only pl. RV. x, 16, 7; ‘fat’, Gmn.), skin, hide, leather, strap of leather, bow-string, sinew (RV. x, 27, 22; AV. i, 2, 3), RV.
= गो॑-ष्टोम (q.v.), AitBr. iv, 15; ŚBr. xiii (see also गो-आयु॑स्)
(pl.) ‘the herds of the sky’, the stars, RV. i, 154, 6 and vii, 36, 1
(m. [also f., Uṇ., Sch.]) rays of light (regarded as the herds of the sky, for which Indra fights with Vṛtra), MBh. i, iii; Hariv. 2943; R. &c.
गो॑ m. the sign Taurus, VarBṛS. xl f.; VarBṛ.; Laghuj.
the sun (cf. -पुत्र), Nir. ii, 6 and 14
the moon, L.
a kind of medicinal plant (ऋषभ), L.
a singer, praiser (fr. √ गै), Naigh. iii, 16
‘a goer’, horse (fr. √ 1. गा), Sāy. on RV. i, 121, 9 and iv, 22, 8
N. of two Ṛṣis of the SV. (with the patr. Āṅgirasa [TāṇḍyaBr. xvi] and Māyūka)
N. of a man (who with Puṣkara is said to be the बलाध्यक्ष of the sons and grandsons of Varuṇa), MBh. ii, 381 (cf. R. vii, 23, 28)
गो॑ m. f. (?) the sun's ray called Suṣumṇa, Nir. ii, 6
गो॑ m. water, BhP. i, 10, 36 (also f. pl., xi, 7, 50)
गो॑ m. an organ of sense, BhP. vii, 5, 30
the eye, Kuval. 70
a billion, TāṇḍyaBr. xvii, 14, 2
गो॑ m. f. the sky, Naigh. i, 4 (perhaps, VS. xxiii, 48)
the thunderbolt, Sāy. on RV. v, 30, 7
the hairs of the body, L.
गो॑ f. an offering in the shape of a cow (= धेनु, q.v.), W.
a region of the sky, L.
(Naigh. i, 1) the earth (as the milk-cow of kings), Mn. iv, xii; MBh.; R. &c.
(hence) the number ‘nine’, Jyot.; Sūryas.
= गो-वीथी, Sch. on VarBṛS. ix, 1 ff.
a mother, L. (cf. VarBṛS. iii, 68)
(Naigh. i, 11) speech, Sarasvatī (goddess of speech), MBh. i, iii, v; Ragh. ii, v; Cāṇ.
voice, note (fr. √ गै), Śiś. iv, 36
N. of Gaurī, Gal.
of the wife [or of a daughter-in-law, BhP. ix, 21, 25] of Śuka (a daughter of the manes called Sukālas), Hariv. 986; MatsyaP.
N. of a daughter of Kakut-stha and wife of Yayāti, Hariv. 1601
गो [cf. βοῦς; Lat. ḃos; Old Germ. chuo; Mod. Germ. Kuh; Eng. cow; Lett. gohw; cf. also γαῖα, γῆ; Goth. gavi and Mod. Germ. Gau.]
